subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Frail
solution:
The correct answer is: **Robust**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Frail **means physically weak, or easily damaged, broken, or harmed. (शारीरिक रूप से कमजोर, या आसानी से क्षतिग्रस्त, टूटा हुआ या क्षतिग्रस्त)

 
 
• Example -* The shirt is old and **frail**, and the threads look ready to part.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Robust **means strong and healthy. (मजबूत और स्वस्थ)
 
 
• Example -* She was in **robust **health.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Frail**' and '**Robust**' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Unreliable **means that cannot be trusted or depended on. (जिस पर भरोसा या भरोसा न किया जा सके)
 
• **Fresh **means having its original qualities unimpaired. (अपने मूल गुणों को अक्षुण्ण रखते हुए)
 
• **Fragile **means easily damaged or broken. (आसानी से क्षतिग्रस्त या टूटा हुआ)
